q_learn_woodcutting.name: Woodcutting: The Sawpit
q_learn_woodcutting.summary: Sawyer Jessa lends an axe to anyone willing to learn the trade, and wants ten logs cut to prove it was worth lending.

stages.desc: Chop 10 logs from the stand behind the sawpit
Bring the 10 logs to Sawyer Jessa

q_learn_woodcutting.completion: Jessa waves the axe away when you offer it back. "It has your swing in it now. Keep it, and keep the pit in mind when you have a load to sell."

q_learn_mining.name: Mining: The Gravel Pit
q_learn_mining.summary: Pitmaster Dorn will put a pickaxe in your hands, and eight lumps of copper back in his, if you can be taught to swing it.

stages.desc: Mine 8 copper ore from the pit face
Bring the 8 copper ore to Pitmaster Dorn

q_learn_mining.completion: Dorn looks at the ore, then at your hands. "The pick is yours. Halda will buy what you dig, and she will teach you what to do with it."

q_learn_fishing.name: Fishing: The Mill Pond
q_learn_fishing.summary: Angler Sula has a spare rod and a pond full of minnow, and will trade the loan of one for six of the other.

stages.desc: Catch 6 minnow from the mill pond
Bring the 6 minnow to Angler Sula

q_learn_fishing.completion: Sula strings the minnow on a withy and hands the rod back to you. "Yours. The lake north of town is better water, and Wendel pays for what you land."

q_learn_fighting.name: Fighting: The Gate Meadow
q_learn_fighting.summary: Watchman Corrin will tell anybody how a fight works, and thinks less of telling than of doing. There are boar in the meadow outside his gate.

stages.desc: Put down 3 boar in the meadow outside the gate
Go back to Watchman Corrin at the gate

q_learn_fighting.completion: Corrin looks you over for blood that is yours. "Three, and you walked back. That is the whole of it -- the rest is the same thing with bigger animals."

q_learn_crafting.name: Crafting: A Bad First Helm
q_learn_crafting.summary: Smith Halda says crafting is hands, not talk. She has put two logs and a hide in yours and wants to see what you make of them.

stages.desc: Make a Barkwood Helm at a workbench
Show it to Smith Halda at the forge

q_learn_crafting.completion: Halda turns it over twice. "It is crooked, the hide is on backwards, and it will turn a blow. Wear it. The next one you make will embarrass this one."

q_learn_cooking.name: Cooking: Meat and Fire
q_learn_cooking.summary: Hunter Ivo's lesson is a short one: meat comes off anything, and you cook it before you eat it. He has handed over some of his own to prove the second half on.

stages.desc: Cook 3 pieces of meat over a fire
Go back to Hunter Ivo

q_learn_cooking.completion: Ivo takes a piece, chews, and says nothing, which from him is a review. "Hides come off anything with fur. You can work the rest out."

q_thin_the_herd.name: Thin the Herd
q_thin_the_herd.summary: Boar have come down out of the greenwood and into the barley. Havenbrook wants them gone before the harvest is.

stages.desc: Hunt wild boar in the meadow

q_thin_the_herd.completion: The barley is safe for another season.

q_firewood.name: Cold Hearths
q_firewood.summary: The inn burned through its winter store early. Bring logs and nobody has to sleep cold.

stages.desc: Gather logs from the meadow trees

q_firewood.completion: The inn will be warm tonight.

q_ore_for_the_forge.name: Ore for the Forge
q_ore_for_the_forge.summary: The smith has orders she cannot fill and a cold forge to fill them with. Copper will do to start.

stages.desc: Mine copper ore from the foothills

q_orc_trouble.name: Trouble on the Road
q_orc_trouble.summary: Orcs have been working the Sunken Road, and the carters have stopped coming through. Make the road boring again.

stages.desc: Drive the orcs off the Sunken Road

q_orc_trouble.completion: The carters will risk the road again.

q_marens_letter.name: Maren's Letter
q_marens_letter.summary: Elder Maren has written to the guild and will not say what about. She only asks that it reach them today.

stages.desc: Take Maren's letter to the guild hall
Return to Elder Maren

q_marens_letter.completion: Maren reads your face more carefully than the reply.

q_the_sunken_road.name: The Sunken Road
q_the_sunken_road.summary: A surveyor went out to the Sunken Road with a satchel of paper and came back with none of it. Maren wants to know what he saw.

stages.desc: Search the Sunken Road for the surveyor's papers
Bring the page back to Elder Maren

q_the_sunken_road.completion: Maren folds the page twice and does not put it down.

q_emberfell_depths.name: The Emberfell Depths
q_emberfell_depths.summary: Whatever is gathering the orcs is doing it under Emberfell. Maren has stopped calling it a rumour.

stages.desc: Find the rusted key in the Emberfell mine
Descend into the lower workings
Put down the Orc Warchief
Carry the totem back to Elder Maren

q_emberfell_depths.completion: Maren turns the totem over once and puts it in the fire.

q_barrow_seal.name: What the Mire Keeps
q_barrow_seal.summary: A water-stained note left at the edge of the Mire. Someone went into the barrow on purpose, and wrote down why.

stages.desc: Enter the barrow beneath the Mire
Recover the barrow seal
Take the seal to the guild master

q_barrow_seal.completion: The guild master puts the seal in a drawer he then locks.

q_a_decent_meal.name: A Decent Meal
q_a_decent_meal.summary: The innkeeper can cook. What she cannot do is leave the inn long enough to find anything worth cooking.

stages.desc: Bring the innkeeper 5 cooked meat
Hand the food to the innkeeper

q_a_decent_meal.completion: She feeds you first, which is how you know it went well.

q_clear_the_trail.name: Clear the Trail
q_clear_the_trail.summary: Boar have come off the Whisperwood verges and onto the trail, and Bram's carts will not go past them. He wants the trail made dull again.

stages.desc: Hunt boar along the Whisperwood Trail

q_clear_the_trail.completion: Bram's first cart gets through without anyone running.

q_word_to_fernhollow.name: Word to Fernhollow
q_word_to_fernhollow.summary: Oona the herbalist has a remedy for Old Wendel's chest, and her knees will not take the north trail any more.

stages.desc: Take Oona's remedy to Old Wendel in Fernhollow
Return to Oona in Mossvale

q_word_to_fernhollow.completion: Oona asks how he looked, and listens to the answer.

q_mossvale_hides.name: Hides for the Tannery
q_mossvale_hides.summary: The tanner has shut up for the season with half the orders unfilled. Mossvale will pay for raw hides brought to the square.

stages.desc: Gather raw hides from the Whisperwood

q_mossvale_hides.completion: The hides go under a tarp by the tannery door until spring.

q_trail_wardens.name: Trail Wardens
q_trail_wardens.summary: Warden Sela is short of hands. Foxes are hunting the trail in packs, and something is teaching them to.

stages.desc: Drive the foxes off the Whisperwood Trail

q_trail_wardens.completion: Sela marks the trail safe on the gate board, in chalk.

q_old_offering.name: The Old Offering
q_old_offering.summary: Mira keeps the shrine at Fernhollow, and the pond has not had its offering since the hunters stopped coming north.

stages.desc: Bring Mira two boar haunches for the shrine

q_old_offering.completion: Mira lays the offering on the stone and does not say what she is listening for.

q_road_beneath_leaves.name: The Road Beneath the Leaves
q_road_beneath_leaves.summary: A weathered trail sign names two settlements beyond the eastern trees. Follow the old road to Mossvale, then take the north fork to Fernhollow.

stages.desc: Follow the eastern forest path into the Whisperwood
Follow the main trail east to Mossvale
Return to the trail fork and follow its north path to Fernhollow

q_road_beneath_leaves.completion: Smoke above the lodge, lamplight on the pond. The names on the sign are places you know now.

q_daily_boar.name: Barley Watch
q_daily_boar.summary: The boar keep coming back to the barley, and somebody has to keep sending them home.

stages.desc: Hunt boar in the Hollowmarch

q_daily_orcs.name: Road Patrol
q_daily_orcs.summary: The Sunken Road needs walking every day it is going to stay open.

stages.desc: Drive orcs off the Hollowmarch roads

q_daily_ore.name: Order: Copper Ore
q_daily_ore.summary: Copper for the smelter. Halda goes through it faster than anyone can dig it.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 10 copper ore

q_daily_ore.completion: Halda weighs it in her hand and nods.

q_daily_kitchen.name: Fish for the Inn
q_daily_kitchen.summary: Bess will cook anything with fins, and the pond and the lake are full of things with fins.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 5 raw minnows

q_daily_kitchen.completion: Fried minnows are on the chalk board by supper.

q_daily_logs.name: Kindling
q_daily_logs.summary: The inn's fires eat a stack of logs a day, and Bess would rather not split them herself.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 10 logs

q_daily_logs.completion: The woodpile by the kitchen door is tall again.

q_daily_foxes.name: Fox Patrol
q_daily_foxes.summary: Warden Sela wants the packs thinned every day until they stop coming back.

stages.desc: Drive foxes off the Whisperwood Trail

q_daily_foxes.completion: Sela chalks another quiet day on the gate board.

q_daily_highwaymen.name: Road Toll
q_daily_highwaymen.summary: Highwaymen are stopping carts on the Whisperwood Trail and taking a toll nobody set. Sela wants them moved on, and they keep coming back.

stages.desc: Drive highwaymen off the Whisperwood Trail

q_daily_highwaymen.completion: Sela pins the toll board they left beside the notices, upside down.

q_daily_hides.name: Tannery Stock
q_daily_hides.summary: The reeve buys hides for the tannery, a few at a time, whenever anyone brings them.

stages.desc: Bring Reeve Hadley 4 raw hides

q_daily_hides.completion: Hadley writes it in the ledger and pays out of his own purse.

q_daily_oak.name: Oak for the Lodge
q_daily_oak.summary: Pell has a buyer in Havenbrook who pays well for seasoned oak and asks no questions about it.

stages.desc: Bring Pell the Trader 5 oak logs

q_daily_oak.completion: Pell loads the oak and whistles.

q_daily_pike.name: Order: Pike
q_daily_pike.summary: Old Wendel will pay for pike, because in forty years he has never caught one himself.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 3 raw pike

q_daily_pike.completion: Wendel says the pond is having him on. He eats well tonight.

q_the_water_remembers.name: The Water Remembers
q_the_water_remembers.summary: Mira says the lights on the pond come from somewhere you can only reach asleep, and that something there has been trying to speak.

stages.desc: Sleep after dusk, in a bed or at a camp, and dream
Find the voice in the dream
Wake, and tell Mira what the voice said

q_the_water_remembers.completion: Mira writes the words down, then burns what she wrote.

q_lights_on_the_pond.name: Lights on the Pond
q_lights_on_the_pond.summary: Hesper has watched the lights over the pond grow brighter every night. Something large is holding the dream together, and it is not friendly.

stages.desc: Put down the Nightmare Brute in the dreamworld
Bring Hesper 6 dream shards as proof

q_lights_on_the_pond.completion: Hesper hangs the shards over the door. The pond is dark tonight.

q_daily_nightmares.name: Nightmares Undone
q_daily_nightmares.summary: Only asleep. The slate in the dream asks for the same thing every night: fewer nightmares.

stages.desc: Defeat nightmares in the dreamworld

q_daily_nightmares.completion: The slate wipes itself clean when you look away.

q_daily_shrine_shards.name: Shards for the Shrine
q_daily_shrine_shards.summary: The slate asks for dream shards to be carried out of the dream and laid at Mira's shrine in Fernhollow.

stages.desc: Wake, and bring Mira 8 dream shards

q_daily_shrine_shards.completion: Mira sets the shards in the water, one at a time.

q_daily_brute.name: The Brute Returns
q_daily_brute.summary: Only asleep. The Nightmare Brute comes back every night. Someone has to put it down again.

stages.desc: Put down the Nightmare Brute

q_daily_brute.completion: For one night, the plateau is quiet.

q_order_iron_ore.name: Order: Iron Ore
q_order_iron_ore.summary: Iron ore, for bars the guild has already paid for.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 8 iron ore

q_order_coal.name: Order: Coal
q_order_coal.summary: Coal to keep the forge hot enough for steel.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 6 coal

q_order_coal.completion: She tips it straight into the bin by the fire.

q_order_azuryte_ore.name: Order: Azuryte Ore
q_order_azuryte_ore.summary: A buyer in the south wants azuryte, and will not say what for.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 4 azuryte ore

q_order_azuryte_ore.completion: Halda holds a piece up to the light and whistles.

q_order_bronze_bars.name: Order: Bronze Bars
q_order_bronze_bars.summary: Bronze bars, smelted and ready, so the apprentices have something to ruin.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 6 bronze bars

q_order_bronze_bars.completion: "Clean pours. You can smelt for me any day."

q_order_iron_bars.name: Order: Iron Bars
q_order_iron_bars.summary: Iron bars for the watch's new hinges and hasps.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 5 iron bars

q_order_iron_bars.completion: She stacks them by the anvil without a word, which from Halda is praise.

q_order_steel_bars.name: Order: Steel Bars
q_order_steel_bars.summary: Steel bars. The guild wants blades, and blades want steel.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 3 steel bars

q_order_steel_bars.completion: "Proper steel. Rings when you knock it."

q_order_bronze_swords.name: Order: Bronze Swords
q_order_bronze_swords.summary: Two bronze swords for the watch's new recruits, who will certainly drop them.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 2 bronze swords

q_order_bronze_swords.completion: Halda tests each edge on her thumbnail.

q_order_iron_sword.name: Order: Iron Sword
q_order_iron_sword.summary: An iron sword for a caravan guard who lost his to the Mire.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 iron sword

q_order_iron_sword.completion: "Balanced. He will not lose this one."

q_order_iron_spear.name: Order: Iron Spear
q_order_iron_spear.summary: An iron spear for a road warden who wants the orcs kept at a distance.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 iron spear

q_order_iron_spear.completion: "Straight shaft, true point. He'll never have to let them close."

q_order_steel_longsword.name: Order: Steel Longsword
q_order_steel_longsword.summary: A steel longsword, commissioned by the guild master himself.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 steel longsword

q_order_steel_longsword.completion: Halda wraps it in oilcloth like something precious.

q_order_hides.name: Order: Hides
q_order_hides.summary: Hides for bellows leather and sword grips. The forge eats leather.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 8 hides

q_order_hides.completion: "That will do the bellows for a month."

q_order_bronze_helms.name: Order: Bronze Helms
q_order_bronze_helms.summary: Two bronze helms for the road wardens.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 2 bronze helms

q_order_bronze_helms.completion: She knocks on one with her knuckles. It rings true.

q_order_iron_cuirass.name: Order: Iron Cuirass
q_order_iron_cuirass.summary: An iron cuirass, fitted for a watchman who will not stop growing.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 iron cuirass

q_order_iron_cuirass.completion: "Good plate. Corrin will complain about the weight anyway."

q_order_steel_greaves.name: Order: Steel Greaves
q_order_steel_greaves.summary: Steel greaves for an adventurer going under Emberfell.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 steel greaves

q_order_steel_greaves.completion: Halda turns them over twice and pays without haggling.

q_order_minnows.name: Order: Minnows
q_order_minnows.summary: Minnows for bait. Wendel will not say what he is baiting for.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 10 raw minnows

q_order_trout.name: Order: Trout
q_order_trout.summary: Trout for the smokehouse behind the cottage.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 6 raw trout

q_order_trout.completion: Wendel lays them out on the jetty in a neat row.

q_order_salmon.name: Order: Salmon
q_order_salmon.summary: Salmon from the Whisperwood stream, for Hesper's birthday. Do not tell her.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 3 raw salmon

q_order_eels.name: Order: Eels
q_order_eels.summary: Eels from the Hollowmarch lake. Wendel swears they are a delicacy.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 2 raw eels

q_order_eels.completion: Wendel looks at them, and they look back. He pays quickly.

q_order_cooked_trout.name: Order: Cooked Trout
q_order_cooked_trout.summary: Cooked trout for the ferry passengers, if there are ever any again.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 5 cooked trout

q_order_cooked_trout.completion: "Still warm. You have a hand for it."

q_order_cooked_minnows.name: Order: Cooked Minnows
q_order_cooked_minnows.summary: A plate of fried minnows for the old man's supper. He says his own always burn.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 8 cooked minnows

q_cellar_vermin.name: Rats in the Cellar
q_cellar_vermin.summary: Something has moved into the inn's cellar: rats in the grain and spiders in the kegs. Bess wants it cleared out.

stages.desc: Kill 6 rats in the inn's cellar
Kill 4 cellar spiders
Kill the Broodmother in the back of the cellar
Tell Innkeeper Bess the cellar is clear

q_cellar_vermin.completion: Bess pours you a drink on the house, and says she will be sweeping webs for a week.

q_ice_spire_dragon.name: The Dragon of the Ice Spire
q_ice_spire_dragon.summary: Elder Vask was one of the Spirewatch, and the only one who came down. What took the summit fifty years ago is still up there, and he has waited that long for somebody who could go back for it.

stages.desc: Climb the Ice Spire to the summit
Kill Hoarfang, the dragon of the Ice Spire
Carry the dragon's fang back to Elder Vask

q_ice_spire_dragon.completion: Vask turns the fang over twice, then sets it down. "Fifty years I have been the only one who saw it. Now there are two of us, and one of them killed it."

q_drowned_hoard.name: The Drowned King
q_drowned_hoard.summary: The guild's oldest ledger says the barrow was opened once before, and the party that did it wrote down a second chamber they never reached. Orlend wants to know whether the ledger was lying.

stages.desc: Go back down into the barrow beneath the Mire
Open the drowned king's chest in the far chamber
Tell Guild Master Orlend what was in it

q_drowned_hoard.completion: Orlend looks at the boots for a long moment. "Keep them. The ledger is forty years of men saying the guild should not have sealed that door, and you have just made every one of them right."

q_dry_well.name: The Dry Well
q_dry_well.summary: Havenbrook's well ran dry the year everything else went wrong, and nobody has been down it since. Bess wants to know what is in the way of the water.

stages.desc: Make a lantern at an anvil and light it with a tinderbox
Climb down the well and find the bottom of the shaft
Clear whatever is sitting in the spring
Open the spring so the water runs again
Tell Innkeeper Bess the well is running

q_dry_well.completion: Bess sends the boy to the square with a bucket before you have finished talking, and the whole street hears him shout when it comes up full.

q_a_place_of_your_own.name: A Place of Your Own
q_a_place_of_your_own.summary: Bess is tired of watching you sort your pack on her tables. The tanner's house at the bottom of Mossvale has stood empty since he went to the coast, and she says the key has always lived under a stone at the gable end.

stages.desc: Find the key under the stone beside the empty house in Mossvale
Let yourself in

q_a_place_of_your_own.completion: The hinges complain and the air is stale, but the roof holds and there is a chest by the wall with nothing in it. Yours, then.

q_order_rawhide_coif.name: Order: Rawhide Coifs
q_order_rawhide_coif.summary: Two rawhide coifs, cut and laced. Every new warden wants one and nobody wants to make them.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 2 rawhide coifs

q_order_rawhide_coif.completion: Nessa turns one inside out, grunts, and pays.

q_order_bedroll.name: Order: Bedrolls
q_order_bedroll.summary: Two bedrolls, blanket and groundsheet both, for whoever is next out of the gate at dusk.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 2 bedrolls

q_order_bedroll.completion: She rolls one out along the bench, looks down it, and rolls it back up.

q_order_rawhide_jerkin.name: Order: Rawhide Jerkins
q_order_rawhide_jerkin.summary: Two rawhide jerkins for the militia, cut close so nothing fouls a draw.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 2 rawhide jerkins

q_order_rawhide_jerkin.completion: They go straight onto the rack by the door.

q_order_leather_jerkin.name: Order: Leather Jerkins
q_order_leather_jerkin.summary: Two boiled leather jerkins. Warmer than they look, and quiet, which is the point.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 2 leather jerkins

q_order_leather_jerkin.completion: She knocks a knuckle against the chest of one and seems satisfied.

q_order_wolfskin.name: Order: Wolfskin Jerkins
q_order_wolfskin.summary: Two wolfskin jerkins. The guild pays her for them and she would rather not sit up sewing.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 2 wolfskin jerkins

q_order_wolfskin.completion: She stacks them by the counter for the guild's runner.

q_order_satchel.name: Order: Hide Satchels
q_order_satchel.summary: A hide satchel, boiled and strapped. The pedlars buy them faster than she can stitch them.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 hide satchel

q_order_satchel.completion: Nessa holds it up by the strap, shakes it, and pays without haggling.

q_order_boiled_chaps.name: Order: Boiled Chaps
q_order_boiled_chaps.summary: Two pairs of boiled chaps, wrapped to the knee. For the wardens working the Whisperwood.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 2 pairs of boiled chaps

q_order_boiled_chaps.completion: She checks the lacing at the knee, which is where they always give.

q_order_scaled_coif.name: Order: Scaled Coifs
q_order_scaled_coif.summary: Two scaled coifs. Lizard scale over hide, and it has to lie flat or it catches the string.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 2 scaled coifs

q_order_scaled_coif.completion: Nessa runs her hand over the scales the wrong way and nods at how little moves.

q_order_pack.name: Order: Wolfskin Packs
q_order_pack.summary: A wolfskin pack on a frame. The Westwold traders order them two at a time and never wait.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 wolfskin pack

q_order_pack.completion: It is on the cart before the coins are in your hand.

q_order_banded_jerkin.name: Order: Banded Jerkins
q_order_banded_jerkin.summary: A banded jerkin, blue-scaled. Somebody in the guild is going up the Ice Spire and wants it by Thursday.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 banded jerkin

q_order_banded_jerkin.completion: She writes a name on a tag and ties it to the collar.

q_order_rucksack.name: Order: Bearskin Rucksacks
q_order_rucksack.summary: A bearskin rucksack, silk-sewn. Only one person in the Hollowmarch makes them and it is not Nessa.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 bearskin rucksack

q_order_rucksack.completion: She turns every seam over, finds nothing to complain about, and says so.

q_order_hide_boots.name: Order: Hide Boots
q_order_hide_boots.summary: Two pairs of hide boots, soft-soled. Nessa sells more of these than of anything else she makes.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 2 pairs of hide boots

q_order_hide_boots.completion: She ties the pairs together by the laces and hangs them on the hook.

q_order_thread_wound.name: Order: Bedrolls for the Gate
q_order_thread_wound.summary: Three more bedrolls. The watch sleeps at the gate on a cold night and Corrin asked nicely.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 3 bedrolls

q_order_thread_wound.completion: She counts them twice, which is how Nessa says thank you.

q_weave_cloth.name: Order: Bolts of Cloth
q_weave_cloth.summary: Six bolts of plain weave. Wynn's wheel is one wheel and the college orders by the dozen.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 6 bolts of cloth

q_weave_cloth.completion: She stacks them by the door for the Fernhollow cart.

q_weave_homespun_hat.name: Order: Homespun Hats
q_weave_homespun_hat.summary: Two homespun hats, brim and cone both. Every apprentice arrives without one and leaves with two.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 2 homespun hats

q_weave_homespun_hat.completion: Wynn turns one on her fist, pinches the brim straight, and pays.

q_weave_homespun_robe.name: Order: Homespun Robes
q_weave_homespun_robe.summary: Two homespun robes for the college's first-years, cut long and sewn plain.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 2 homespun robes

q_weave_homespun_robe.completion: They go on the rail with the others, tagged in her own hand.

q_weave_novice_skirt.name: Order: Novice Skirts
q_weave_novice_skirt.summary: Two novice skirts, dyed and hemmed, for whoever is going up to Fernhollow this season.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 2 novice skirts

q_weave_novice_skirt.completion: She checks the hem against her arm, which is how she measures everything.

q_weave_novice_robe.name: Order: Novice Robes
q_weave_novice_robe.summary: Two novice robes. The dye is the hard part and the dye is why she pays for them.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 2 novice robes

q_weave_novice_robe.completion: Wynn holds one to the light to see whether the colour took evenly. It did.

q_weave_apprentice_hat.name: Order: Apprentice's Hats
q_weave_apprentice_hat.summary: Two apprentice's hats, stiffened and banded. The college will not have a soft brim.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 2 apprentice's hats

q_weave_apprentice_hat.completion: She sets them on the shelf where the college's order goes.

q_weave_apprentice_robe.name: Order: Apprentice's Robes
q_weave_apprentice_robe.summary: An apprentice's robe, mantled and trimmed. It takes her a day and she has three days of other work.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 apprentice's robe

q_weave_apprentice_robe.completion: She writes a name on a tag and ties it to the collar.

q_weave_journeyman_robe.name: Order: Journeyman's Robes
q_weave_journeyman_robe.summary: A journeyman's robe. Somebody at the college has been promoted and wants it by Whitsun.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 journeyman's robe

q_weave_journeyman_robe.completion: Wynn says the college pays late and orders often, and she is not complaining.

q_weave_adept_robe.name: Order: Adept's Robes
q_weave_adept_robe.summary: An adept's robe, blue-dyed and silk-sewn. There are two people in the Hollowmarch who can make one.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 adept's robe

q_weave_adept_robe.completion: She looks along every seam, finds nothing, and says so, which from Wynn is a speech.

q_oona_marigold.name: Order: Marigolds
q_oona_marigold.summary: A basket of marigolds for the drying racks. They grow in any meadow.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 8 marigolds

q_oona_marigold.completion: Oona sorts them by the head, quickly, and keeps all but one.

q_oona_brookmint.name: Order: Brookmint
q_oona_brookmint.summary: Brookmint from the waterside, cut before it flowers.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 8 sprigs of brookmint

q_oona_brookmint.completion: "Cut clean. Somebody taught you, or you have been paying attention."

q_oona_nettle.name: Order: Nettles
q_oona_nettle.summary: Stinging nettles, and gloves are your own affair.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 8 stinging nettles

q_oona_nettle.completion: She takes them bare-handed, which answers a question nobody asked.

q_oona_bogbean.name: Order: Bogbean
q_oona_bogbean.summary: Bogbean out of the mire. Mind what else lives in it.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 6 bogbean

q_oona_bogbean.completion: "Wet to the knee for it, I expect. It is worth the knee."

q_oona_sage.name: Order: Mountain Sage
q_oona_sage.summary: Sage from the foothills, the higher the better.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 6 mountain sage

q_oona_sage.completion: The whole room smells of it before she has the sack open.

q_oona_glowcap.name: Order: Glowcaps
q_oona_glowcap.summary: Glowcaps from the deep wood, picked by their own light.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 6 glowcaps

q_oona_glowcap.completion: She puts them in the dark cupboard, where they go on glowing.

q_oona_draughts.name: Order: Healing Draughts
q_oona_draughts.summary: Healing draughts for the loggers, who will not be told.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 3 healing draughts

q_oona_draughts.completion: Oona holds one to the window. "Clear. You strained it. Good."

q_oona_nettle_brew.name: Order: Nettle Brew
q_oona_nettle_brew.summary: Nettle brew for the sawpit: it is what Jessa swears by.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 3 nettle brews

q_oona_nettle_brew.completion: "Strong. She will complain about the taste and ask for more."

q_oona_bitters.name: Order: Fen Bitters
q_oona_bitters.summary: Fen bitters, for the marsh cough that goes round each autumn.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 3 fen bitters

q_oona_bitters.completion: She tastes it, which nobody should, and nods.

q_oona_stoneskin.name: Order: Stoneskin Draughts
q_oona_stoneskin.summary: Stoneskin for the watch at Havenbrook, before the orcs come down again.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 3 stoneskin draughts

q_oona_stoneskin.completion: "Corrin will pretend he does not need it. He will drink it."

q_oona_focus.name: Order: Hunter's Focus
q_oona_focus.summary: Hunter's Focus, for a trapper who has started missing.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 3 Hunter's Focus

q_oona_focus.completion: Oona stoppers them twice. "It is his eyes. This will not mend those, but he will think it has."

q_shut_the_crypt.name: Shut the Crypt
q_shut_the_crypt.summary: Watchman Brask walks the same round every night, and lately the round has a noise in it: something scratching under Hollowrest. Brask would like it to stop, and would like not to be the one who goes down.

stages.desc: Put down the dead walking in the Vaults of Hollowrest Crypt
Put down the shades on the crypt's second floor
Tell Watchman Brask the scratching has stopped

q_shut_the_crypt.completion: Brask listens at the gate for a long minute. "Nothing. Good. I will still walk the long way round it."

q_toll_at_the_bridge.name: The Toll at the Bridge
q_toll_at_the_bridge.summary: Hollis the Carter does not stop at the bridge for anybody, and the men who wait there have started standing in the road. Hollis would like the road back.

stages.desc: Drive off the highwaymen waiting on the Westwold road
Tell Hollis the Carter the road is clear

q_toll_at_the_bridge.completion: Hollis counts the coins twice out of habit. "First run in a month I will not have to whip the horse."

q_white_pelts.name: White Pelts
q_white_pelts.summary: Sorrel carries wolf pelts to Ivo for a living. Ivo has asked for white ones -- the fell wolves off the Westwold's high ground -- and Sorrel has seen what wears them.

stages.desc: Bring Sorrel three fell wolf pelts from the Westwold

q_white_pelts.completion: Sorrel runs a hand through the fur the wrong way and nods. "Ivo will say they are too big. Ivo will pay anyway."

q_hags_of_the_bayou.name: The Singers in the Bayou
q_hags_of_the_bayou.summary: Warden Ilse keeps a gate nobody attacks, and it is dull. The ferry has started bringing up folk from the Bayou with their wits turned round and a tune they cannot stop humming, and that is not.

stages.desc: Kill the Swamp Hags singing in the Bayou
Tell Warden Ilse the singing has stopped

q_hags_of_the_bayou.completion: Ilse writes something on the gate board, crosses it out, and writes it again smaller. "There. Quiet post."

q_horns_for_the_forge.name: Horns for the Forge
q_horns_for_the_forge.summary: There is an old smith's story that demon horn, ground fine and thrown on the coals, burns hot enough to work the hard metals. Garrow the Smith would like to find out, and would like somebody else to fetch the horns.

stages.desc: Bring Garrow four demon horns from the Ashen Path

q_horns_for_the_forge.completion: The first horn goes on the coals and the forge goes white. Garrow laughs out loud, which nobody in Mossvale can remember hearing before.

q_the_den_mother.name: The Den Mother
q_the_den_mother.summary: Hale the Trapper has lost three lines of traps and one good dog to the she-bear who keeps the den in the Brackenwood. Hale would like her gone, and does not expect to be the one who does it.

stages.desc: Kill the Den Mother in her den
Tell Hale the Den Mother is dead

q_the_den_mother.completion: Hale goes out to the den the next morning to see for certain, and comes back with a new line of traps and nothing to say, which is how Hale says thank you.

q_bears_in_the_brackenwood.name: Bears in the Brackenwood
q_bears_in_the_brackenwood.summary: The Mossvale lodge buys its hides from trappers in the Brackenwood, and the trappers have stopped going in: the bears have come down onto the paths. Warden Sela would like the paths back before the reeve asks again.

stages.desc: Thin out the bears on the Brackenwood's paths
Tell Warden Sela the paths are clear

q_bears_in_the_brackenwood.completion: Word goes to the lodge the same day. The first hides come in a week later, with a bottle from the lodge-master for the warden at the gate.

q_doll_in_the_reeds.name: The Doll in the Reeds
q_doll_in_the_reeds.summary: A reed doll hung on a post in the Bayou, thorns through its heart and red thread round its neck. The lizardfolk hang them where their matriarch has passed, and taking one down is a challenge. It has been heard.

stages.desc: Kill the lizardfolk who come looking for their doll
Kill the Bayou Matriarch, whose doll it is

q_doll_in_the_reeds.completion: With the matriarch dead the thorns work loose from the doll on their own, and the red thread goes brown. It is only reeds now.

q_drowned_locket.name: The Drowned Locket
q_drowned_locket.summary: A locket in the Bayou mud, the hinge rusted shut, and something inside it that knocks. The drowned in the Bayou do not lie still, and one of them may be looking for it. Mira of the Shrine at Fernhollow knows about things that knock.

stages.desc: Lay the Bayou's restless dead back down
Take the locket to Mira of the Shrine at Fernhollow

q_drowned_locket.completion: There was a curl of hair in the locket, tied with thread. Mira laid it on the shrine stones and said a name the locket did not have written in it, and the knocking stopped.

q_tongueless_bell.name: The Tongueless Bell
q_tongueless_bell.summary: The iron tongue of a bell, lying in the grass at Hollowrest as if it had been dropped in a hurry. Somewhere under the graveyard a bell is trying to ring without it. Old Perrin in Havenbrook is old enough to remember when it still could.

stages.desc: Go down to the second floor of Hollowrest Crypt, where the bell is
Put down the dead gathered under the tongueless bell
Take the clapper to Old Perrin in Havenbrook

q_tongueless_bell.completion: Perrin took the clapper to the smith. On the next still evening Havenbrook heard a bell it had forgotten it used to hear.

q_ashcroft_letter.name: A Letter Sealed in Black
q_ashcroft_letter.summary: A letter in black wax, lying on the second floor of Hollowrest Crypt and addressed to the Guild of Havenbrook. The seal is Lord Ashcroft's, and Lord Ashcroft is supposed to be dead. Whatever he is now, he is at the bottom of the crypt.

stages.desc: Find Lord Ashcroft at the bottom of Hollowrest Crypt, and end him
Take the letter to Guild Master Orlend in Havenbrook

q_ashcroft_letter.completion: The letter was an offer: Ashcroft's crypt left alone, and in return the guild's dead left alone. A Guild Master sixty years gone had signed it. Orlend burned it in the grate and did not say which.

q_cinder_invitation.name: An Invitation in Cinders
q_cinder_invitation.summary: An invitation lying on the Ashen Path, gold-edged and written in scorch marks: the Cinder King requests the pleasure of your company at the Brimstone Palace. Your name was not on it until you picked it up.

stages.desc: Present yourself at the Brimstone Palace
Take your seat in the palace's dining hall
Decline the Cinder King's hospitality, permanently

q_cinder_invitation.completion: When the Cinder King falls, the invitation in your pack goes cold for the first time. The party is over.

q_rime_key.name: The Rime Key
q_rime_key.summary: A key of ice that does not melt, lying in the dungeon under the Brimstone Palace with SPIREWATCH scratched into it. Something frozen was keeping it, and has noticed it gone. Elder Vask in Havenbrook was one of the Spirewatch.

stages.desc: Kill the Rime Revenant that was keeping the key
Bring the Rime Key to Elder Vask in Havenbrook

q_rime_key.completion: Vask has told the story of the Spirewatch for fifty years with the end missing. Now he knows how it ended.

q_bloodied_collar.name: The Bloodied Collar
q_bloodied_collar.summary: A sheepdog's collar in the Westwold grass, bitten through, the brass tag reading JUNIPER. The wolves that cross the Wend at night have been taking more than sheep. Farmer Aldous keeps a flock out on the Westwold.

stages.desc: Hunt the wolves that cross into the Westwold
Take the collar to Farmer Aldous

q_bloodied_collar.completion: Juniper's collar hangs on the nail by Aldous's gate, where she used to sit.

q_antler_circlet.name: The Antler Circlet
q_antler_circlet.summary: An antler circlet in the Brackenwood, green wire and two tines, with tooth marks in it and a trapper's mark cut into the wire. The wolves in the wood have got bold. Hale the Trapper will know whose mark it is.

stages.desc: Drive back the wolves that have got bold in the Brackenwood
Take the circlet to Hale the Trapper

q_antler_circlet.completion: Hale bent the wire straight and gave the circlet back to the girl it was made for. She said it was ruined, and wore it anyway.

q_order_bronze_daggers.name: Order: Bronze Daggers
q_order_bronze_daggers.summary: Three bronze daggers for the tannery. Nessa goes through them faster than she goes through hides.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 3 bronze daggers

q_order_bronze_daggers.completion: Halda tests each edge on her thumbnail and nods three times.

q_order_iron_shields.name: Order: Iron Shields
q_order_iron_shields.summary: Two iron shields for the watch on the west gate, who have been using the lids of barrels.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 2 iron shields

q_order_iron_shields.completion: "Corrin will say they are heavy. Corrin says everything is heavy."

q_order_steel_mace.name: Order: Steel Mace
q_order_steel_mace.summary: A steel mace for the reeve of Mossvale, who says he does not need one and has asked for it twice.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 steel mace

q_order_steel_mace.completion: She weighs it in one hand. "He will need it."

q_order_steel_helm.name: Order: Steel Helm
q_order_steel_helm.summary: A steel helm for a guild member who has been hit on the head once too often to argue about the price.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 steel helm

q_order_steel_helm.completion: "Tell him it will not help with the arguing."

q_order_azuryte_bars.name: Order: Azuryte Bars
q_order_azuryte_bars.summary: Azuryte bars. The forge can work them now it is hot enough; the Ice Spire's guides pay well for what comes of them.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 4 azuryte bars

q_order_azuryte_bars.completion: The bars ring blue on the anvil. Halda looks pleased, which is rare.

q_order_azuryte_mace.name: Order: Azuryte Mace
q_order_azuryte_mace.summary: An azuryte mace for a troll-hunter going up the Spire. Trolls do not mind edges.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 azuryte mace

q_order_azuryte_mace.completion: "The blue does not show the blood. He asked specially."

q_order_azuryte_helm.name: Order: Azuryte Helm
q_order_azuryte_helm.summary: An azuryte helm for the Ice Spire's lead guide, whose last one a wyvern took home.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 azuryte helm

q_order_azuryte_helm.completion: She polishes a thumbprint off the crown before she pays.

q_order_damascus_bars.name: Order: Damascus Bars
q_order_damascus_bars.summary: Damascus bars, the banded steel from the Ashen Path. The palace road's traders cannot get enough of it.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 3 damascus bars

q_order_damascus_bars.completion: She turns one to the light to watch the bands move. "Good folding."

q_order_damascus_sword.name: Order: Damascus Sword
q_order_damascus_sword.summary: A damascus sword for a knight of the Plateau, who has sent a drawing of how it should look and a note about the drawing.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 damascus sword

q_order_damascus_sword.completion: "It is better than the drawing. Do not tell him."

q_order_damascus_shield.name: Order: Damascus Shield
q_order_damascus_shield.summary: A damascus shield for the Stronghold's gate, where they have stopped counting what comes at it.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 damascus shield

q_order_damascus_shield.completion: Halda raps it with a hammer and listens. It does not ring. She pays.

q_order_damascus_greaves.name: Order: Damascus Greaves
q_order_damascus_greaves.summary: Damascus greaves for a guard on the Ashen Path, where the ground itself bites.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 damascus greaves

q_order_damascus_greaves.completion: "His shins will thank you. He will not; he is not the sort."

q_order_orichalcum_bars.name: Order: Orichalcum Bars
q_order_orichalcum_bars.summary: Orichalcum bars. Halda has three commissions waiting on them and a fourth she has not agreed to.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 3 orichalcum bars

q_order_orichalcum_bars.completion: The bars are warm in her hands long after they should be cold.

q_order_orichalcum_spear.name: Order: Orichalcum Spear
q_order_orichalcum_spear.summary: An orichalcum spear for a Brimstone Palace scout, who needs to reach what should not be let close.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 orichalcum spear

q_order_orichalcum_spear.completion: "A spear of that is a year's work anywhere else. You did it this week."

q_order_orichalcum_cuirass.name: Order: Orichalcum Cuirass
q_order_orichalcum_cuirass.summary: An orichalcum cuirass for the Guild Master, who does not know it is being made and would say it was too much.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 orichalcum cuirass

q_order_orichalcum_cuirass.completion: Halda wraps it in sacking. "If Orlend asks, it came from nowhere."

q_order_diamond_ingots.name: Order: Diamond Ingots
q_order_diamond_ingots.summary: Diamond ingots, pressed from rough stones at a heat Halda had to build a new flue for.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 2 diamond ingots

q_order_diamond_ingots.completion: She holds one up to the fire and the whole forge goes white.

q_order_diamond_greatsword.name: Order: Diamond Greatsword
q_order_diamond_greatsword.summary: A diamond greatsword for a champion of the College lists, who breaks swords the way other people break bread.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 diamond greatsword

q_order_diamond_greatsword.completion: "He will not break this one. He will try."

q_order_diamond_boots.name: Order: Diamond Boots
q_order_diamond_boots.summary: Diamond boots for a walker of the Glass Mere, who says the ice has started to listen for footsteps.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 diamond boots

q_order_diamond_boots.completion: "Harl never needed boots like these. Harl was lucky."

q_order_platinum_bars.name: Order: Platinum Bars
q_order_platinum_bars.summary: Platinum bars for the College's orrery, which needs metal that does not tarnish in a thousand years.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 2 platinum bars

q_order_platinum_bars.completion: "They will outlast the College. They will outlast me."

q_order_platinum_greataxe.name: Order: Platinum Greataxe
q_order_platinum_greataxe.summary: A platinum greataxe for the Warlord's Howe expedition. Nobody has come back from the Howe with an axe.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 platinum greataxe

q_order_platinum_greataxe.completion: She swings it once, slowly, and the air in the forge moves.

q_order_platinum_greaves.name: Order: Platinum Greaves
q_order_platinum_greaves.summary: Platinum greaves for a knight who means to walk the Hexmire's temple, and to walk back out.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 platinum greaves

q_order_platinum_greaves.completion: "Heavy enough to stand in, light enough to run in. Tell her which to do."

q_order_demonite_bars.name: Order: Demonite Bars
q_order_demonite_bars.summary: Demonite bars, smelted with shards of the dream. Halda will not say who they are for.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 2 demonite bars

q_order_demonite_bars.completion: She takes them with tongs, and puts the tongs away afterwards, somewhere else.

q_order_demonite_sword.name: Order: Demonite Sword
q_order_demonite_sword.summary: A demonite sword for the one who hunts in the Reverie. It has to cut things that are not there.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 demonite sword

q_order_demonite_sword.completion: "It hums. Do not stand close to it while it hums."

q_order_demonite_cuirass.name: Order: Demonite Cuirass
q_order_demonite_cuirass.summary: A demonite cuirass for someone going down into the Infernal Pit on purpose.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 demonite cuirass

q_order_demonite_cuirass.completion: Halda pays more than she asked and does not explain.

q_order_dracon_bar.name: Order: A Dracon Bar
q_order_dracon_bar.summary: A dracon bar, demonite folded with a dragon's fang. Halda wants to see one made before she dies.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 dracon bar

q_order_dracon_bar.completion: She is quiet for a long while. "My master never saw one."

q_order_dracon_helm.name: Order: Dracon Helm
q_order_dracon_helm.summary: A dracon helm for whoever is next to climb the Ice Spire after the dragon. Somebody always is.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 dracon helm

q_order_dracon_helm.completion: "Whoever wears it, the dragons will know what it is made of."

q_order_dracon_dagger.name: Order: Dracon Dagger
q_order_dracon_dagger.summary: A dracon dagger, as a gift from the Guild to the Palace. Nobody else is to know what is in the box.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 dracon dagger

q_order_dracon_dagger.completion: She puts it in the box herself and nails the lid.

q_order_enchanted_bar.name: Order: An Enchanted Bar
q_order_enchanted_bar.summary: An enchanted bar: dracon folded through the dream. There is no second smith in the world to ask.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 enchanted bar

q_order_enchanted_bar.completion: Halda does not touch it. She looks at it, and then at you, for a long time.

q_order_enchanted_sword.name: Order: Enchanted Sword
q_order_enchanted_sword.summary: An enchanted sword. The order came with no name, no place and a great deal of gold.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 enchanted sword

q_order_enchanted_sword.completion: "Whoever it is for, they will be the last to need a sword."

q_order_enchanted_shield.name: Order: Enchanted Shield
q_order_enchanted_shield.summary: An enchanted shield for Havenbrook's own gate, to hang there where the town can see it.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 1 enchanted shield

q_order_enchanted_shield.completion: She hangs it over the forge first, for one night, to look at.

q_order_damascus_ore.name: Order: Damascus Ore
q_order_damascus_ore.summary: Damascus ore from the Ashen Path. It has to be dug before it cools, and it never quite does.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 5 damascus ore

q_order_damascus_ore.completion: She drops it in the quench and it hisses for a minute.

q_order_orichalcum_ore.name: Order: Orichalcum Ore
q_order_orichalcum_ore.summary: Orichalcum ore. Halda has a buyer, and a buyer behind the buyer.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 5 orichalcum ore

q_order_orichalcum_ore.completion: "Clean ore. Whoever showed you that seam, do not show anyone else."

q_order_diamond_ore.name: Order: Rough Diamonds
q_order_diamond_ore.summary: Rough diamonds from the deep seams, for pressing into ingots.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 4 rough diamonds

q_order_diamond_ore.completion: She counts them twice, and then once more when she thinks you are not looking.

q_order_platinum_ore.name: Order: Platinum Ore
q_order_platinum_ore.summary: Platinum ore. It does not look like much until it is melted, and then it looks like everything.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 4 platinum ore

q_order_platinum_ore.completion: "Heavy for its size. So are you, to have carried it."

q_order_demonite_ore.name: Order: Demonite Ore
q_order_demonite_ore.summary: Demonite ore from the Infernal Pit. Halda keeps it in a lead box and does not say why.

stages.desc: Bring Smith Halda 3 demonite ore

q_order_demonite_ore.completion: The lead box goes under the anvil, and the anvil does not go anywhere.

q_order_bearskin_chaps.name: Order: Bearskin Chaps
q_order_bearskin_chaps.summary: Bearskin chaps for the Westwold drovers, who ride through thorn all winter.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 2 bearskin chaps

q_order_bearskin_chaps.completion: "They will outlast the drovers. They usually do."

q_order_trollhide_chaps.name: Order: Trollhide Chaps
q_order_trollhide_chaps.summary: Trollhide chaps for a pair of guides on the Ice Spire. Troll hide does not freeze.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 2 trollhide chaps

q_order_trollhide_chaps.completion: Nessa bends one double and lets it spring back. "Good. Good."

q_order_wyvernscale_jerkin.name: Order: Wyvernscale Jerkin
q_order_wyvernscale_jerkin.summary: A wyvernscale jerkin for a ranger of the Plateau, who has been wearing wool and regretting it.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 wyvernscale jerkin

q_order_wyvernscale_jerkin.completion: She runs a thumb against the scales and they catch. "That will stop a claw."

q_order_wyvernscale_coif.name: Order: Wyvernscale Coifs
q_order_wyvernscale_coif.summary: Wyvernscale coifs for the Ashen Path's scouts, who need their heads and would like to keep them.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 2 wyvernscale coives

q_order_wyvernscale_coif.completion: "Two heads, kept. That is a good day's work."

q_order_demonhide_chaps.name: Order: Demonhide Chaps
q_order_demonhide_chaps.summary: Demonhide chaps for somebody walking the burning ground by the Infernal Pit.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 demonhide chaps

q_order_demonhide_chaps.completion: "They smell of sulphur. Tell him they always will."

q_order_demonhide_jerkin.name: Order: Demonhide Jerkin
q_order_demonhide_jerkin.summary: A demonhide jerkin. Nessa has never worked demonhide and wants to see it done properly once.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 demonhide jerkin

q_order_demonhide_jerkin.completion: She looks at every seam. "I will do the next one myself. Probably."

q_order_greatwolf_jerkin.name: Order: Greatwolf Jerkin
q_order_greatwolf_jerkin.summary: A greatwolf jerkin for the Glass Mere's trappers, who have taken over Old Harl's lines.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 greatwolf jerkin

q_order_greatwolf_jerkin.completion: "Harl would have wanted one. Harl would never have paid for one."

q_order_haversack.name: Order: Greatwolf Haversack
q_order_haversack.summary: A greatwolf haversack for an expedition to the Warlord's Howe, carrying enough to come back.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 greatwolf haversack

q_order_haversack.completion: "If they come back, it will be because of what was in this."

q_order_direbear_chaps.name: Order: Direbear Chaps
q_order_direbear_chaps.summary: Direbear chaps for a knight of the Stronghold, who wants something between him and the ground.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 direbear chaps

q_order_direbear_chaps.completion: Nessa whistles. It is the first time anybody has heard her whistle.

q_order_dreadhide_jerkin.name: Order: Dreadhide Jerkin
q_order_dreadhide_jerkin.summary: A dreadhide jerkin for the Reverie's hunter. It has to be tanned in the dark.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 dreadhide jerkin

q_order_dreadhide_jerkin.completion: She does not look at it long. "Put it in the dark again. Please."

q_order_dragonhide_jerkin.name: Order: Dragonhide Jerkin
q_order_dragonhide_jerkin.summary: A dragonhide jerkin. Nessa has kept the scraps of the last one on her wall for twenty years.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 dragonhide jerkin

q_order_dragonhide_jerkin.completion: She holds it up to the wall where the scraps are. "That is how it should have been."

q_order_dreamhide_jerkin.name: Order: Dreamhide Jerkin
q_order_dreamhide_jerkin.summary: A dreamhide jerkin, cut from something that was never quite there to skin.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 dreamhide jerkin

q_order_dreamhide_jerkin.completion: "I cannot see where you have stitched it. I do not think there is anywhere."

q_order_dreamhide_coif.name: Order: Dreamhide Coif
q_order_dreamhide_coif.summary: A dreamhide coif. Whoever wears it will not dream again, the buyer says, and is glad of it.

stages.desc: Bring Nessa 1 dreamhide coif

q_order_dreamhide_coif.completion: Nessa puts it on for a moment, and takes it off quickly.

q_weave_journeyman_skirt.name: Order: Journeyman's Skirts
q_weave_journeyman_skirt.summary: Journeyman's skirts for two students passing out of the College, a year late and very proud of it.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 2 journeyman's skirts

q_weave_journeyman_skirt.completion: "The hems are straight. They will not be by the end of the year."

q_weave_adept_hat.name: Order: Adept's Hats
q_weave_adept_hat.summary: Adept's hats for the College's air lane, whose last hats went up and did not come down.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 2 adept's hats

q_weave_adept_hat.completion: Wynn ties the brims down with a thread, just in case.

q_weave_sage_robe.name: Order: Sage's Robe
q_weave_sage_robe.summary: A sage's robe for a lector of the College, who will be reading in it for forty years.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 sage's robe

q_weave_sage_robe.completion: "Forty years, and it will still fall right."

q_weave_sage_skirt.name: Order: Sage's Skirt
q_weave_sage_skirt.summary: A sage's skirt to go with the lector's robe. She will not wear one without the other.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 sage's skirt

q_weave_sage_skirt.completion: "She is right. They are a pair."

q_weave_magister_robe.name: Order: Magister's Robe
q_weave_magister_robe.summary: A magister's robe, gold-threaded, for the College's own magister. Nobody else has ever been asked.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 magister's robe

q_weave_magister_robe.completion: Wynn folds it in tissue as if it might break.

q_weave_magister_gloves.name: Order: Magister's Gloves
q_weave_magister_gloves.summary: Magister's gloves, for casting without burning one's fingers, which the magister has done twice.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 2 magister's gloves

q_weave_magister_gloves.completion: "Three times, she told me. She is counting the first one now."

q_weave_luminous_robe.name: Order: Luminous Robe
q_weave_luminous_robe.summary: A luminous robe that gives its own light. The College's night readers will not have to squint.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 luminous robe

q_weave_luminous_robe.completion: The shop is brighter while it is in it.

q_weave_astral_skirt.name: Order: Astral Skirt
q_weave_astral_skirt.summary: An astral skirt, the colour of the sky an hour after sundown, for a watcher of the stars.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 astral skirt

q_weave_astral_skirt.completion: "It is the right blue. There is only one right blue."

q_weave_astral_robe.name: Order: Astral Robe
q_weave_astral_robe.summary: An astral robe for the College orrery's keeper, who says the stars have started watching back.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 astral robe

q_weave_astral_robe.completion: Wynn does not say anything, which is how you know it is her best.

q_weave_nightweave_robe.name: Order: Nightweave Robe
q_weave_nightweave_robe.summary: A nightweave robe, woven in the dark from thread that is darker. For somebody going into the Reverie awake.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 nightweave robe

q_weave_nightweave_robe.completion: "I could not see to weave it. I am not sure you could either."

q_weave_dragonweave_robe.name: Order: Dragonweave Robe
q_weave_dragonweave_robe.summary: A dragonweave robe, with fire in the weft. It will not burn, and nor will whoever wears it.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 dragonweave robe

q_weave_dragonweave_robe.completion: She holds a candle to the hem. Nothing happens. She is delighted.

q_weave_dreamweave_robe.name: Order: Dreamweave Robe
q_weave_dreamweave_robe.summary: A dreamweave robe. Wynn has had the pattern since she was a girl, and never the hands.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 dreamweave robe

q_weave_dreamweave_robe.completion: She cries, a little, and then charges the buyer double and gives you half.

q_weave_dreamweave_hat.name: Order: Dreamweave Hat
q_weave_dreamweave_hat.summary: A dreamweave hat to finish the set. The buyer says a robe without a hat is a sentence without a stop.

stages.desc: Bring Wynn 1 dreamweave hat

q_oona_emberbloom.name: Order: Emberbloom
q_oona_emberbloom.summary: Emberbloom from the Cursed Reach, for a fever draught. It has to be picked with gloves and carried with care.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 6 emberbloom

q_oona_emberbloom.completion: Oona takes them with tongs. "And they say I am the dangerous one."

q_oona_moonpetal.name: Order: Moonpetal
q_oona_moonpetal.summary: Moonpetal from the Reverie. It only grows in dreams, which is where you will have to go.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 5 moonpetal

q_oona_moonpetal.completion: "Still cold. They are always cold. It is how you know."

q_oona_starlily.name: Order: Starlily
q_oona_starlily.summary: Starlily, the rarest thing Oona has ever asked for. She wants it for a panacea she has only read about.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 4 starlily

q_oona_starlily.completion: Oona is quiet for a moment. "My mother saw one once. Just the once."

q_oona_skimmer.name: Order: Skimmer Tonic
q_oona_skimmer.summary: Skimmer tonic for the College's apprentices, who have been casting on empty and falling asleep in lectures.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 3 skimmer tonics

q_oona_skimmer.completion: "They will stay awake now. Whether they listen is another matter."

q_oona_emberfire.name: Order: Emberfire Elixir
q_oona_emberfire.summary: Emberfire elixir for the Stronghold's garrison, who have to hold the gate all night.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 3 emberfire elixirs

q_oona_cinderbug.name: Order: Cinderbug Ward
q_oona_cinderbug.summary: Cinderbug wards for somebody walking the burning ground to the Brimstone Palace.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 2 cinderbug wards

q_oona_cinderbug.completion: She seals the stoppers with wax. "Two. Tell him not to be brave and drink them both at once."

q_oona_moonlit.name: Order: Moonlit Draught
q_oona_moonlit.summary: Moonlit draughts for the College's night classes, which have got very difficult lately.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 3 moonlit draughts

q_oona_moonlit.completion: The draughts move in the vials while she holds them. She holds them a long time.

q_oona_rimeshell.name: Order: Rimeshell Ward
q_oona_rimeshell.summary: Rimeshell wards for the trappers crossing the Glass Mere, who have been losing toes.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 2 rimeshell wards

q_oona_rimeshell.completion: "No more toes. That is a promise I can keep."

q_oona_panacea.name: Order: Starlily Panacea
q_oona_panacea.summary: Starlily panacea. Oona has a patient nothing else will reach.

stages.desc: Bring Oona 2 starlily panaceas

q_oona_panacea.completion: She takes one straight upstairs, and does not come down for an hour.

q_order_pike_lot.name: Order: A Lot of Pike
q_order_pike_lot.summary: Five pike for the Mossvale lodge's winter barrels. Wendel says the barrels are bigger than they look.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 5 raw pike

q_order_pike_lot.completion: "Into the salt with them. The barrels thank you."

q_order_cooked_pike.name: Order: Cooked Pike
q_order_cooked_pike.summary: Cooked pike for the jetty-hands' supper, who have been eating minnows and complaining.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 4 cooked pike

q_order_cooked_pike.completion: Wendel eats one before he pays. "For quality."

q_order_cooked_salmon.name: Order: Cooked Salmon
q_order_cooked_salmon.summary: Cooked salmon for the College's feast day, where Wendel has been asked to bring the fish course.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 3 cooked salmon

q_order_cooked_salmon.completion: "They will think I cooked it. Let them."

q_order_cooked_eel.name: Order: Cooked Eel
q_order_cooked_eel.summary: Cooked eel, which Wendel swears is a delicacy and nobody else will eat.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 2 cooked eels

q_order_cooked_eel.completion: He eats one with his eyes closed and looks very happy.

q_order_salmon_smokehouse.name: Order: The Smokehouse
q_order_salmon_smokehouse.summary: Six salmon for the smokehouse Wendel has built behind the jetty and will not let anyone see.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 6 raw salmon

q_order_salmon_smokehouse.completion: Smoke rises behind the jetty for three days afterwards.

q_order_eel_barrel.name: Order: A Barrel of Eels
q_order_eel_barrel.summary: A barrel of eels for the Barley and Bell's harvest supper. Bess did not ask for them. Wendel is sending them anyway.

stages.desc: Bring Old Wendel 5 raw eels

q_bess_meat.name: Order: Cooked Meat
q_bess_meat.summary: Cooked meat for the taproom's supper. Anything, as long as it is hot and there is plenty.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 6 portions of cooked meat

q_bess_meat.completion: "Plenty, and hot. You would be surprised how many cannot manage both."

q_bess_chicken.name: Order: Roast Chicken
q_bess_chicken.summary: Roast chicken for the carters, who come in off the road hungry enough to eat the table.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 5 roast chickens

q_bess_chicken.completion: She puts them straight on the pass. "Go on, before they start on the table."

q_bess_oats.name: Order: Honeyed Oats
q_bess_oats.summary: Honeyed oats for the lodgers' breakfast. Bess has overslept and will not say so.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 4 honeyed oats

q_bess_mutton.name: Order: Roast Mutton
q_bess_mutton.summary: Roast mutton for a wedding party in the upstairs room, who have already eaten the first lot.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 4 plates of roast mutton

q_bess_mutton.completion: Cheering comes down the stairs a minute after they go up.

q_bess_skewers.name: Order: Hunter's Skewers
q_bess_skewers.summary: Hunter's skewers for a party going out after boar at first light.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 3 hunter's skewers

q_bess_trout.name: Order: Cooked Trout

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 4 cooked trout

q_bess_trout.completion: The smell brings two people in off the street before she has paid you.

q_bess_stew.name: Order: Hearty Stew

q_bess_stew.completion: "Corrin will have two bowls. Corrin always has two bowls."

q_bess_pies.name: Order: Traveller's Pies
q_bess_pies.summary: Traveller's pies for a caravan leaving for the Westwold at dawn.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 3 traveller's pies

q_bess_pies.completion: She wraps them in cloth. "They will be better cold. They always are."

q_bess_broth.name: Order: Fisherman's Broth

q_bess_broth.completion: "Do not tell Wendel it was not mine. Or do. I want to see his face."

q_bess_pike.name: Order: Cooked Pike
q_bess_pike.summary: Cooked pike for the guild's table, who have got tired of mutton and said so, loudly.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 3 cooked pike

q_bess_pike.completion: "Pike. Let them complain about pike now."

q_bess_tea.name: Order: Moonpetal Tea
q_bess_tea.summary: Moonpetal tea for the College students staying over before their examinations.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 3 pots of moonpetal tea

q_bess_tea.completion: "They will pass, or they will sleep. Either way, they will stop pacing."

q_bess_supper.name: Order: Farmer's Supper
q_bess_supper.summary: Farmer's supper for the last day of harvest, which Havenbrook eats at the inn every year.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 2 farmer's suppers

q_bess_supper.completion: The whole taproom bangs the tables when it goes out.

q_bess_salmon.name: Order: Cooked Salmon
q_bess_salmon.summary: Cooked salmon for a councillor from Fernhollow, who is here to be impressed.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 3 cooked salmon

q_bess_harvest.name: Order: The Harvest Feast

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 4 farmer's suppers

q_bess_harvest.completion: Bess sits down for the first time all day. "That is the feast done. Now the washing."

q_bess_eel.name: Order: Cooked Eel
q_bess_eel.summary: Cooked eel, because Wendel sent a barrel and Bess refuses to waste it.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 2 cooked eels

q_bess_eel.completion: "It is not bad. Do not tell Wendel it is not bad."

q_bess_minnows.name: Order: Fried Minnows
q_bess_minnows.summary: Fried minnows for the bar, where they go out by the bowlful to people waiting for their supper.

stages.desc: Bring Innkeeper Bess 8 cooked minnows

q_bess_minnows.completion: "They will be gone before you are out of the door. Listen."

q_oonas_poppet.name: What the Doll Was For
q_oonas_poppet.summary: The thorns have worked out of the reed doll and its thread has gone brown, but it is still warm in the hand. Oona the Herbalist in Mossvale knows old things. Take it to her.

stages.desc: Take the reed doll to Oona in Mossvale
Lay the poppet on a witch's table in the Bayou
Complete 3 waves of enemies to complete the ritual

q_oonas_poppet.completion: The fire sinks into the mud and the fen goes quiet. The poppet lies on the table where you left it, one knot tighter in its red thread than it was.

q_poppets_hunger.name: Five Knots
q_poppets_hunger.summary: A poppet has to be fed before it gives anything back, Oona says: one ritual a day at a witch's table in the Bayou, until all five of its knots are pulled tight. Then bring it to her, and she will open it.

stages.desc: Complete the ritual at a witch's table, once a day, until all five knots are tight
Bring the full poppet to Oona in Mossvale

q_poppets_hunger.completion: Oona cuts the five knots one after another, and the reeds fall open like a split pod. Inside, where there should be nothing at all, is everything it was fed.

stages.desc: Put down Nightmare Monolith Conjures in the Bayou, dreaming

q_bounty_bayou_monolith_conjure.completion: The name runs off the slate like water.

q_bounty_bayou_maelstrom_conjure.name: Bounty: Maelstrom Conjures

q_bounty_bayou_maelstrom_conjure.completion: The name runs off the slate like water.

q_bounty_bayou_cyclone_conjure.completion: The name runs off the slate like water.

q_bounty_bayou_thunder_conjure.completion: The name runs off the slate like water.

q_pro_meet_mayor.name: Meet the Mayor
q_pro_meet_mayor.summary: A note by the bed you woke in: "If you wake before I come to see you, come to the Mayor's Hall. We must speak!"

stages.desc: Find the Mayor at the Mayor's Hall

q_pro_wake_sleeper.name: Wake a Sleeper
q_pro_wake_sleeper.summary: Every morning fewer doors in Havenbrook open. Mayor Hale wants to know if you, who went down and came back up, can wake one of those who did not.

stages.desc: Enter a villager's home and try to wake them
Report to the Mayor

q_pro_experiment.name: The Experiment
q_pro_experiment.summary: The stranger has locked you in a cell under his house. "Sleep here tonight, and let us see what happens to you."

stages.desc: Rest on the mattress
Explore the dream

q_pro_arm.name: Arm Yourself
q_pro_arm.summary: The old man in the cell down the corridor says there is a chest in the cell across from his. "Take a weapon. Your dreams can turn dangerous."

stages.desc: Open the chest in the cell across from the old man

q_pro_arm.completion: Whoever packed this chest meant it to be found.

q_pro_escape.name: Escape the Mansion
q_pro_escape.summary: Vigil: "Take the stairs up. Get out of this house."

stages.desc: Climb the stairs
Get out of the house
Run down the gate road

q_pro_first_blood.name: First Blood
q_pro_first_blood.summary: Two suits of armour stepped down off their pedestals in the stranger's foyer. The doors will not open while they stand.

stages.desc: Defeat the animated armor

q_pro_anyone_awake.name: Anyone Awake?
q_pro_anyone_awake.summary: Havenbrook is silent: everyone you have found is asleep where they sat down. Somebody must still be awake.

stages.desc: Search Havenbrook for a villager who is still awake

q_act1_vask.name: What Troubles Elder Vask
q_act1_vask.summary: Elder Vask rocks on the guild hall's porch, eyes shut, arguing with someone only he can see. He is half in the Reverie, and fighting something there.

stages.desc: Use the Dreamcatcher on Elder Vask
Free Elder Vask from what holds his dream

q_act1_break_hold.name: Break the Hold
q_act1_break_hold.summary: In his dream, Elder Vask: "I can feel the roots: three out along the edges and one thick one in the square. Cut them loose, whoever you are."

stages.desc: Clear the Hushed in the streets
Release the Nightmare Holds
Destroy the Nightmare Anchor in the town square

q_act1_bells.name: Ring the Dawn Bells
q_act1_bells.summary: Where the Anchor stood, the dark peeled off an old bell frame hidden at the centre of the square: the Dawn Bells, pale, and glowing faintly.

stages.desc: Ring the Dawn Bells in the town square

q_act1_gather.name: Learn to Gather
q_act1_gather.summary: Woken by the Dawn Bells, Havenbrook's woodcutter, angler and miner each want to repay you the only way they know how: by teaching you their trade.

stages.desc: Learn from the woodcutter, the angler and the miner

q_act1_gather.completion: Three trades, three teachers. The town is starting to feel like somewhere you could live.

q_act1_tut_wood.name: Woodcutting
q_act1_tut_wood.summary: Sawyer Jessa: "Now you. Do just what I did."

stages.desc: Chop the marked tree

q_act1_tut_fish.name: Fishing
q_act1_tut_fish.summary: Angler Sula: "Patience first, quick hands second. Now you try."

stages.desc: Catch fish from the mill pond

q_act1_tut_mine.name: Mining
q_act1_tut_mine.summary: Pitmaster Dorn: "Two taps to find the crack, one hard strike to finish it. Now you."

stages.desc: Mine the marked vein

q_act1_forge.name: The Silent Forge
q_act1_forge.summary: No smoke rises from the forge's chimney. A forge is never meant to be cold.

stages.desc: Investigate the forge
Defeat the Black Knights
Check on Halda

q_act1_save_halda.name: Save Halda
q_act1_save_halda.summary: The knights were only her jailers. Halda is still in the Reverie, gripping a hammer that isn't there.

stages.desc: Use the Dreamcatcher on Halda
Cross the causeway to the platform
Defeat the Forge Demon
Break the Anchor
See how Halda is

q_act1_save_halda.completion: Halda's forge is lit again, and her anvil rings for the first time in days. Her smithing is yours to call on.

q_act1_bess.name: Where's Bess?
q_act1_bess.summary: The tavern is as you left it, only emptier: stools overturned, a half-full mug on the bar, Bess's apron on its hook. Bess herself is nowhere.

stages.desc: Find Bess
Find the three brass tokens hidden around the inn
Open the cellar door
Clear the cellar of nightmare spiders
Find Bess

q_act1_save_bess.name: Save Bess
q_act1_save_bess.summary: Bess lies tangled in webbing at the foot of the cellar stairs, counting something in her sleep.

stages.desc: Use the Dreamcatcher on Bess
Clear the nightmare spiders
Ring the Dawn Chime
See how Bess is

q_act1_save_bess.completion: Bess is up and about, and whenever you're hungry there's a hot meal at her bar with your name on it. No arguments.

q_act1_supper.name: Supper at Bess's
q_act1_supper.summary: A hot meal at Bess's bar with your name on it.

stages.desc: Sit down at Bess's bar

q_act1_supper.completion: Bess sets a plate down in front of you and dares you to reach for your purse.

q_act1_hides.name: The Haunted Hides
q_act1_hides.summary: The woodcutter: "All those nights I lay dreaming, I swear I heard wolves, circling down by the tannery. Might be worth looking in on the Tanner."

stages.desc: Investigate the tannery
Try to wake the Tanner

q_act1_save_tanner.name: Save the Tanner
q_act1_save_tanner.summary: Nessa sits bolt upright at her bench with a skinning knife clenched in her fist, her breath fogging in the warm air as if she stood in a winter wood.

stages.desc: Use the Dreamcatcher on the Tanner
Defeat the four nightmare wolves
Break the Anchor
See how the Tanner is

q_act1_save_tanner.completion: "Anything you need cured or tanned, it's on me." Nessa's tannery is open again.

q_act1_finale.name: The Mayor's Dream
q_act1_finale.summary: Halda, Bess, the Tanner and the clothier are awake. Mayor Hale is still asleep at his desk -- or he was.

stages.desc: Go to the Mayor's Hall
Defeat the Black Knights to escape
Go inside the Guild Hall
Defeat the Black Knights
Strike down the Anchor
Ring the last Dawn Bell
Wake with Havenbrook

q_act1_finale.completion: A house in Havenbrook with a good bed in it, and the Guild's gift. Havenbrook is awake.

q_chime_posy.name: Dawn Chimes: Posy
q_chime_posy.summary: Posy is asleep, and dreaming something that hums. The Dreamcatcher tugs toward them.

stages.desc: Break the mini anchor
Ring the Dawn Chimes
See how Posy is

q_chime_posy.completion: Posy is awake, and back about their day.

q_chime_tobin.summary: Tobin is asleep, and dreaming something that hums. The Dreamcatcher tugs toward them.

See how Tobin is

q_chime_tobin.completion: Tobin is awake, and back about their day.
