stages.desc: Break the mini anchor
Ring the Dawn Chimes
See how Hollis is

q_chime_hollis.completion: Hollis is awake, and back about their day.

q_guild_ledger.name: The Guild's Ledger
q_guild_ledger.summary: Guild Master Orlend has opened the Guild's ledger of named beasts to you: a bounty on each of the Hollowmarch's worst, posted on the board beside his desk, and paid the day the beast falls.

stages.desc: Read the bounties on the board beside Orlend's desk

q_guild_ledger.completion: The first pages are pinned up in his own hand. Every name on them has killed somebody who thought they were ready.

q_guild_broodmother.name: Bounty: The Broodmother
q_guild_broodmother.summary: A spider the size of a cartwheel has nested in the cellar under the Barley and Bell, among Bess's kegs. Her bite poisons, and when she rears back, the bite that follows poisons worse. Take food down with you.

stages.desc: Slay the Broodmother in the cellar under the Barley and Bell

q_guild_broodmother.completion: Struck from the ledger. Bess has her cellar back, and says she will believe it when she has been down there.

q_guild_lizardman_chief.name: Bounty: The Lizardman Chief
q_guild_lizardman_chief.summary: The lizardmen camped north-west of Havenbrook, on the way to the Bayou, answer to a chief half again the size of the rest. He keeps his warriors close: thin them out before you call him. His cuts bleed, and his heavy blow leaves your head ringing.

stages.desc: Slay the Lizardman Chief at the Lizardmen's Camp

q_guild_lizardman_chief.completion: Struck from the ledger. The camp will find another chief. The Guild will find another bounty.

q_guild_barrow_wight.name: Bounty: The Hollowrest Wight
q_guild_barrow_wight.summary: Something keeps the door of Hollowrest Crypt, in the graveyard west of Havenbrook, and lets nobody past who is still breathing. It is cold to stand near and colder to be struck by, and it does not bleed or sicken.

stages.desc: Slay the Hollowrest Wight at the door of Hollowrest Crypt

q_guild_barrow_wight.completion: Struck from the ledger. The crypt door stands open for anyone foolish enough to want it.

q_guild_orc3.name: Bounty: The Orc Warchief
q_guild_orc3.summary: The orcs who took Emberfell Mine are led from its lower workings by a warchief who has never lost a fight he started. He sees you coming a long way off. His blade burns, and his heavy blow can leave you seeing double.

stages.desc: Slay the Orc Warchief in Emberfell Mine's lower workings

q_guild_orc3.completion: Struck from the ledger. Without him, the mine's orcs will be at each other's throats inside a week.

q_guild_well_warden.name: Bounty: The Thing in the Spring
q_guild_well_warden.summary: Havenbrook's well ran dry the bad year, and this is why. Down the Deep Cut, where the spring used to rise, something waits in the water's place. It reaches further than it looks, every blow it lands leaves you soaked, and it does not bleed.

stages.desc: Slay the Thing in the Spring at the bottom of the Deep Cut

q_guild_well_warden.completion: Struck from the ledger. The Guild has paid for stranger news, but not lately.

q_guild_den_mother.name: Bounty: The Den Mother
q_guild_den_mother.summary: Hale the Trapper's she-bear: three lines of traps and one good dog, so far. She dens in the Brackenwood and does not care for visitors. Her claws open you up, and her heavy blow knocks the sense out of you.

stages.desc: Slay the Den Mother in the Brackenwood

q_guild_den_mother.completion: Struck from the ledger. Hale the Trapper will want to hear it from you.

q_guild_wyvern_matriarch.name: Bounty: The Wyvern Matriarch
q_guild_wyvern_matriarch.summary: She nests at the top of the Ice Spire and hunts the whole climb below it. Her strikes come cold enough to slow you, and slow is how people come off that mountain. Mind the summit: she is not the only thing that nests up there.

stages.desc: Slay the Wyvern Matriarch on the Ice Spire's summit

q_guild_wyvern_matriarch.completion: Struck from the ledger. The climb is no safer for it, but it is quieter.

q_guild_pit_lord.name: Bounty: The Pit Lord
q_guild_pit_lord.summary: A demon of the old kind, at the bottom of the Infernal Pit. It knows you are there long before you know where it is, and every blow it lands sets you alight. Some days it walks out across the Ashen Path; the Guild pays wherever it falls.

stages.desc: Slay the Pit Lord at the bottom of the Infernal Pit

q_guild_pit_lord.completion: Struck from the ledger. The Guild has no record of anybody doing that before, so it has started one.

q_guild_bayou_matriarch.name: Bounty: The Mother of the Fen
q_guild_bayou_matriarch.summary: The lizardfolk of the Bayou have a mother, and she keeps to the deep water at its far western end. Poison does not touch her, and water is her own. She is quick for her size, and whatever she catches bleeds.

stages.desc: Slay the Mother of the Fen in the Bayou

q_guild_bayou_matriarch.completion: Struck from the ledger. The fen is quieter. The Guild does not trust a quiet fen.

q_guild_hex_priest.name: Bounty: The Voodoo High Priest
q_guild_hex_priest.summary: The cult in the Hexmire kneels to a priest who never leaves his sanctum. He fights from arm's length: hexes, pins, a word that turns your feet the wrong way. Close the distance and stay close, and mind the blow that throws you clear.

stages.desc: Slay the Voodoo High Priest in the Hexmire's sanctum

q_guild_hex_priest.completion: Struck from the ledger. The cult will want another priest. Let it want.

q_guild_cerberus.name: Bounty: Cerberus
q_guild_cerberus.summary: Three heads and one temper, prowling the Stronghold on Purgatory's Plateau -- though not every day: the Guild's scouts count six days in ten. It is faster than you, it breathes fire from a distance, and fire does not burn it. There is no outrunning it, so do not try.

stages.desc: Slay Cerberus in the Plateau's Stronghold

q_guild_cerberus.completion: Struck from the ledger. All three heads, the Guild's clerk insists on writing.

q_guild_vampire_lord.name: Bounty: Lord Ashcroft
q_guild_vampire_lord.summary: The last lord of the house under Hollowrest, dead before anyone now living was born, and not as dead as the ledger used to say. He keeps the Black Vault at the bottom of the crypt. He is quick, he draws blood, and nothing that bleeds, sickens or chills the living troubles him.

stages.desc: Slay Lord Ashcroft in the Black Vault of Hollowrest Crypt

q_guild_vampire_lord.completion: Struck from the ledger in Orlend's own hand. The page is older than he is.

q_guild_abominable_snowman.name: Bounty: The Abominable Snowman
q_guild_abominable_snowman.summary: The trappers of the Frostreach swear it is real, and nobody else believes them. It is seen on the Rimefall Glacier now and then, and on the Glass Mere less often than that. It throws ice at anything that moves, hits harder than anything else up there, and frost does not slow it.

stages.desc: Slay the Abominable Snowman in the Frostreach

q_guild_abominable_snowman.completion: Struck from the ledger. The Guild owes the trappers of the Frostreach an apology, and has decided to owe it.

q_guild_cinder_king.name: Bounty: The Cinder King
q_guild_cinder_king.summary: He holds court at the far end of the Ashen Path, in the Brimstone Palace, from a throne nobody has walked away from. Everything about him burns, fire does not touch him, and his heavy blow throws you across the room.

stages.desc: Slay the Cinder King on his throne in the Brimstone Palace

q_guild_cinder_king.completion: Struck from the ledger. The Guild has had the page framed.

q_guild_nightmare_troll.name: Bounty: The Sleepless
q_guild_nightmare_troll.summary: Not everything the Guild pays for walks the waking world. The Sleepless keeps to the Deep Reverie, a ladder below the first, though some days it walks out into the far fens and the high country. It is slow, and its heavy blow leaves you reeling. Dying in a dream only wakes you.

stages.desc: Slay the Sleepless in the Deep Reverie

q_guild_nightmare_troll.completion: Struck from the ledger. The clerk asked how the Guild is to know. Orlend told him the Guild knows.

q_guild_nightmare_dragon.name: Bounty: The Unwaking
q_guild_nightmare_dragon.summary: At the bottom of the Reverie, in the Dreaming Dark, a dragon that has never woken fights in its sleep. It reaches further than anything you will have fought, its cold slows you, and its heavy blow can freeze you where you stand. Dying in a dream only wakes you: bring enough to try again.

stages.desc: Slay the Unwaking in the Dreaming Dark

q_guild_nightmare_dragon.completion: Struck from the ledger. Orlend reads the line twice, and leaves it.

q_guild_quintessence.name: Bounty: The Quintessence
q_guild_quintessence.summary: Past the rift in the Stronghold, at the heart of the Primordium where the five elements run together, something is made of all of them at once. It casts each of them in turn, and fire, frost and lightning slide off it. The last page in the ledger. The Guild has never paid it.

stages.desc: Slay the Quintessence at the Conflux

q_guild_quintessence.completion: The last page in the ledger, struck through. Orlend closes the book and does not open it again that day.

q_act1_clothier.name: The Unfinished Dress
q_act1_clothier.summary: Faint, steady snipping from the clothier's shuttered shop, though the whole town is asleep.

stages.desc: Look inside the clothier's shop
Try to wake the clothier

q_act1_clothier.completion: Wynn does not wake. Whatever she is sewing, she is sewing it in the Reverie.

q_act1_save_clothier.name: Save the Clothier
q_act1_save_clothier.summary: Wynn sleeps in her chair beside the loom, her head on her arm. In her dream a dress will not finish.

stages.desc: Use the Dreamcatcher on the clothier
Study the portrait in her dream
In the waking shop, cut the portrait's colours from the thread wall: crimson for the bodice, ivory for the skirt, gold for the sash
Dress the form in her dream
Defeat the Shear Mannequin
Cut the black thread
See how the clothier is

q_act1_save_clothier.completion: "Take the loom. It has sat idle too long. Make yourself something worth wearing." Wynn's loom is yours to use.

q_act1_neighbors.name: Word to the Neighbors
q_act1_neighbors.summary: Mayor Hale: "If that man could reach into our beds, he can reach into theirs." The road runs down through Whisperwood and splits, one branch to Mossvale and one to Fernhollow.

stages.desc: Take the road through Whisperwood to the fork
Warn Mossvale
Warn Fernhollow
Return to the Mayor

q_act1_neighbors.completion: "Whatever he wants, he isn't finished. You've earned a moment to breathe."

q_act2_torn_pages.name: Torn Pages
q_act2_torn_pages.summary: Four pages have been ripped out of Apocolo's recipe book, and the cure for the sleepers is on them. Each torn stub carries a trace of where its page went: grave dirt, a green scale, a tuft of coarse brown fur, and a greasy grey handprint.

stages.desc: Find the page with grave dirt on it: the graveyard north-west of Havenbrook
Find the page with a green scale on it: the lizardmen's cave by their camp in the mire
Find the page with brown fur on it: the bear's den in the Westwold
Find the greasy page: the orc warlord's chest in Emberfell's lower workings
Mend Apocolo's book on Oona's bench
Brew the cure at Apocolo's cauldron in Havenbrook

q_act2_torn_pages.completion: The brew clears to a pale gold, and a row of vials fills one by one.

q_act2_wake_neighbors.name: Wake the Neighbors
q_act2_wake_neighbors.summary: Apocolo's cure, one dose a sleeper. The Dreamcatcher still cannot reach them; the potion goes round whatever is in the way.

stages.desc: Wake Mossvale
Wake Fernhollow

q_act2_wake_neighbors.completion: Both villages awake -- all but the college, where the potion has not reached.

q_act2_mossvale_house.name: A House in Mossvale
q_act2_mossvale_house.summary: Mayor Hale has a deed on file: a house in Mossvale nobody lives in. Fifty thousand -- thirty, for the hero of the town.

stages.desc: Pay Mayor Hale thirty thousand coins at the Mayor's Hall

q_act2_mossvale_house.completion: The key to the house in Mossvale is yours.

q_act2_hoarfang.name: Icespire's Peak
q_act2_hoarfang.summary: The shadow over Havenbrook was Hoarfang. Elder Vask was a dragon slayer in his warrior days, and took down every dragon that crossed his path. He is not as nimble as he was: he asked you to slay the beast for him at Icespire's Peak, and bring him back its head.

stages.desc: Climb Icespire's Peak
Slay Hoarfang
Bring Hoarfang's head to Elder Vask on the guild hall porch

q_act2_hoarfang.completion: Vask lays five weapons on the porch rail, each crafted from Hoarfang, and pushes the great head across to you, ready to mount on a mantle.

q_act2_college.name: Into the College
q_act2_college.summary: Everyone outside the Magic college at Fernhollow is awake. The college is the one place the cure has not reached.

stages.desc: Go into the college at Fernhollow

q_act2_college.completion: Vexel is gone, and the rival with him or at your feet.

q_act2_wake_college.name: Wake the College
q_act2_wake_college.summary: Magister Orrin is awake, but most of his college still sleeps: the mage council in the great hall, the staff in the other chambers, and the rest of his students. Wake them, a dose each, and he will teach you the arts of the ancient magics.

stages.desc: Wake the mage council in the great hall
Wake the staff: the practice hall and the lecture room
Wake the rest of the students

q_act2_ashen_path.name: The Ashen Path
q_act2_ashen_path.summary: The mage council owes you its waking. The traces of Vexel Von Finch's magic lead toward the Ashen Path, and they asked you to investigate it for any sign of him.

stages.desc: Go onto the Ashen Path
Go down into the Infernal Pit
Defeat the Pit Lord
Search the Pit Lord's dwelling

q_act2_ashen_path.completion: A rune behind the Pit Lord's throne opens a doorway into the Reverie.

q_act2_tell_headmaster.name: Tell the Headmaster
q_act2_tell_headmaster.summary: The rune in the Pit Lord's dwelling opens a doorway into the Reverie. Someone at the Magic college has to hear of this.

stages.desc: Fight your way out of the Ashen Path
Take the rune to the Magic college at Fernhollow

q_act2_tell_headmaster.completion: The council has heard everything, and the choice was yours.

q_act2_death_talisman.name: The Death Talisman
q_act2_death_talisman.summary: The old Dreamwalkers carried a talisman that opened the veil for them, in and out, as they pleased. The college teaches that the closest thing to dreaming is death, and death has a guardian: deep in the crypt beneath the cemetery, the Ashlord, a vampire lord, stands guard over a chest. Go when you are strong enough, and not before.

stages.desc: Go down to the bottom of Hollowrest Crypt
Defeat the Ashlord
Take the talisman from the chest

q_act2_death_talisman.completion: The talisman is warm to the touch, and it hums.

q_charter_iron.name: The Charter: The Mire Road
q_charter_iron.summary: One of the Guild's commissions. Set its survey marks at the Lizardmen's Camp in the Mire, where its map runs out, earn Orla the Tanner's word, and Guild Master Orlend will put the Guild's iron seal on you for it.

stages.desc: Set the Guild's survey marks at the Lizardmen's Camp in the Mire
Earn Orla the Tanner's word: Scale and Reed
Report to Guild Master Orlend

q_charter_iron.completion: Orlend inks it onto the Guild's map from your notes, and the Iron Seal of the Guild goes round your neck.

q_charter_steel.summary: One of the Guild's commissions. Set its survey marks in the Brackenwood's Old Growth, where its map runs out, earn Hale the Trapper's word, and Guild Master Orlend will put the Guild's steel seal on you for it.

stages.desc: Set the Guild's survey marks in the Brackenwood's Old Growth
Earn Hale the Trapper's word: The Den Mother
Report to Guild Master Orlend

q_charter_steel.completion: Orlend inks it onto the Guild's map from your notes, and the Steel Seal of the Guild goes round your neck.

Report to Guild Master Orlend

Earn Elder Vask's word: The Spirewatch's Own
Report to Guild Master Orlend

Earn Wren the Bard's word: The Song Nobody Finishes

q_scale_and_reed.name: Scale and Reed
q_scale_and_reed.summary: Orla the Tanner wants lizard scale, and nobody brings it: the lizardfolk have started hanging reed dolls along the Mire. Five scales, and a look at the painted hide their chief keeps in his hut.

stages.desc: Bring Orla five lizard scales from the Lizardmen's Camp
Put down the Lizardman Chief at the camp
Take the painted hide from beside the chief's hut
Show Orla the painted hide

q_scale_and_reed.completion: Orla cut you a jerkin from the scale you brought, and read the hide: not a hunting map, a road, going west into water.

q_reed_road.name: The Reed Road
q_reed_road.summary: The marks on the chief's hide are a road, Orla says, and it ends in the Bayou. Follow it to whatever the lizardfolk have built there, then tell Warden Ilse at Fernhollow, whose ferry keeps bringing people out of that water.

stages.desc: Follow the hide's road west to the Bayou
Find the sunk shrine where the road ends
Tell Warden Ilse at Fernhollow what the lizardfolk are marking

q_reed_road.completion: Ilse heard it out and asked you, for once, to help her with something.

q_dream_collector_1.name: Things with a Dream Still in Them
q_dream_collector_1.summary: The Collector's better cases are open, and the next ones are for things from further down: the Deep Reverie, where Havenbrook's sleepers walk. Put six of the Sleepwalkers to rest.

stages.desc: Climb down the ladder into the Deep Reverie
Put six Sleepwalkers to rest in the Deep Reverie
Tell the Collector what they were

q_dream_collector_1.completion: Havenbrook's own, dreaming, the Collector said. And something at the bottom of that depth is not dreaming at all.

q_dream_collector_2.name: The One That Does Not Sleep
q_dream_collector_2.summary: At the bottom of the Deep Reverie is the Sleepless, which never closes its eyes. The Collector would like it to.

stages.desc: Put down the Sleepless, at the bottom of the Deep Reverie
Tell the Collector it is done

q_dream_collector_2.completion: The Collector lifted the cloth off a case you had not seen before.

q_coal_1.name: Hotter Than Coal
q_coal_1.summary: Garrow works platinum with demon horn, and Hulda Anvilhand is not impressed. She wants what a dragon breathes with: the glands behind a Pyre Dragon's jaw.

stages.desc: Bring Hulda two pyre glands from the Pyre Dragons on the Plateau

q_coal_1.completion: The forge went from orange to white in a breath, and Hulda worked diamond flat in four blows while Garrow pretended not to look.

q_coal_2.name: Darker Than Coal
q_coal_2.summary: There is a darker fire than a dragon's, Hulda says: an Abyssal Demon's horn burns without any light at all. Two of them.

stages.desc: Bring Hulda two abyssal horns

q_coal_2.completion: The metal went dark red and soft as wax. "Demonite," Hulda said. "Now we are smiths."

q_coal_3.name: Older Than Coal
q_coal_3.summary: One more fire: the one that was lit before there was anything to burn. An Ember Core from the Primordium's Kiln -- and then Hulda's hammer to Halda in Havenbrook, with a message.

stages.desc: Bring Hulda an Ember Core from the Kiln
Take Hulda's hammer to Smith Halda in Havenbrook

q_coal_3.completion: Halda hung Hulda's hammer over her own anvil, and sent back a message of her own: nothing.

q_breaths_1.name: The First Two Breaths
q_breaths_1.summary: The College used to send its adepts up Purgatory's Plateau to learn the elements off the things that breathe them, and stopped fifty years ago without saying why. Battlemaster Ysolde wants a report: the earth's breath and the fire's first.

stages.desc: Put down a Basalt Dragon on the Pale Ascent
Put down a Pyre Dragon on the Ascent or the Scoured Flats
Tell Lector Maud what the earth and the fire did

q_breaths_1.completion: The Lector wrote it all down, and underlined the part where the stone smothered the fire twice.

q_breaths_2.name: Water and Air
q_breaths_2.summary: The Lector's circle wants its other two: the sea's breath and the wind's.

stages.desc: Put down a Brine Dragon on the Brine Terraces
Put down a Gale Dragon on the Flats or the Terraces
Tell Lector Maud what the water and the air did

q_breaths_2.completion: Four of four, the Lector said, and the circle closed -- and then asked you about the fifth, which is not in it.

q_breaths_3.name: The Breath Outside the Circle
q_breaths_3.summary: The storm's breath is in no lecture. Ysolde wants it seen, and the old adepts wrote about something else at the top of the Plateau: a rift in the Stronghold.

stages.desc: Put down a Storm Dragon round the Stronghold
Read what is scratched at the rift inside the Stronghold
Tell Battlemaster Ysolde about the rift

q_breaths_3.completion: That was why they stopped, Ysolde said. Not the dragons: the adepts came back wanting to know where breath comes from.

q_black_water_1.name: Black Water
q_black_water_1.summary: The knots on the poppet are cord, not reed, and Oona has seen that knot once before: on a jar of light out of the swamp north of the Bayou. Go and see who is tying them.

stages.desc: Put down six Voodoo Cultists in the Cypress Drowns
Find where the cult ties its knots
Tell Oona whose knot it is

q_black_water_1.completion: The same knot, Oona said, laying the two side by side.

q_black_water_2.name: The Drums
q_black_water_2.summary: The Shellbacks are at war with the cult and take its cord off its dead, and the cult beats three drums in the Candle Fens to call whatever it calls. Oona wants the drums stopped.

stages.desc: Put down a Shellback Elder on the Strand
Break the cult's three drums in the Candle Fens
Tell Oona the drums are quiet

q_black_water_2.completion: The ferrymen noticed the quiet before Oona did.

q_black_water_3.name: The One They Answer To
q_black_water_3.summary: The cult answers to its High Priest, in the Sanctum behind its temple. When he is gone, Oona will burn his cord.

stages.desc: Put down the Voodoo High Priest in the Sanctum
Bring Oona the High Priest's cord

q_black_water_3.completion: Oona put the cord in the fire and watched it go to the end. Her mother's mother tied the first one.

q_spirewatch_1.name: The Spirewatch's Own
q_spirewatch_1.summary: Twelve of the Spirewatch went up the Ice Spire and one came down. The other eleven were laid in the old mounds of the Frostreach, and the mounds do not keep their dead any more. Elder Vask would like to know which of his are walking, and would like them to stop.

stages.desc: Cross west from the Ice Spire into the Frostreach
Find the Spirewatch's cairn in the Draugr Barrows
Put the eleven to rest: eleven of the draugr in the Barrows
Tell Elder Vask

q_spirewatch_1.completion: Vask said the eleven names, one by one. The captain's was not on the stone: her sword was never in the mound.

q_spirewatch_2.name: The Captain's Sword
q_spirewatch_2.summary: The Spirewatch's captain was not laid with her sword. Old Harl, who keeps the cabin on the Glass Mere, would know where it went: read what he wrote.

stages.desc: Read Old Harl's journal, in the cabin on the Glass Mere
Find the captain's sword out on the Glass Mere
Bring the sword to Elder Vask

q_spirewatch_2.completion: Vask hung the sword over his door, where he can see it from his chair. Now the twelve of them are home.

q_fortieth_winter.name: The Fortieth Winter
q_fortieth_winter.summary: Old Harl's journal stops in the middle of a line: trap four at the Howe door, something taking from it that does not eat, gone to look. Follow his trapline.

stages.desc: Follow Harl's trapline across the Rimefall Glacier
Go into the Howe after him
Put down the Undead Warlords in the Howe's hall
Find Harl's pack by the eldest's seat
The white one came onto the ice: put down the Abominable Snowman
Take Harl's knife to Hale the Trapper in the Brackenwood

q_fortieth_winter.completion: Hale and Harl trapped together for thirty years. Hale gave you the cabin on the Mere, and Harl's chest in it.

q_song_1.name: The Song Nobody Finishes
q_song_1.summary: Wren knows a fourth song. It starts on the burnt road and stops at a drawbridge, because nobody who crossed it came back to sing the rest. Find the verses.

stages.desc: Find what is left of the herald by the moat, at the burnt road's end
Read the verse cut into the stone in the Brimstone Palace's foyer
Bring Wren the first two verses

q_song_1.completion: Wren had them by heart before you finished telling them, and wanted the rest.

q_song_2.name: The Last Verse
q_song_2.summary: The song ends at the Cinder King's table. Find his guest list in the Dining Hall, and then the King.

stages.desc: Find the guest list in the Dining Hall
Put down the Cinder King
Bring Wren the end of the song

q_song_2.completion: Wren sang it through at the inn, and for once the room went quiet and listened.

q_world_made_1.name: What the World Was Made Of
q_world_made_1.summary: The elements are what the land lends you, Magister Orrin has taught for forty years, and he never once asked who lent them to the land. Through the rift in the Stronghold: bring him the heart of the fire and of the stone.

stages.desc: Go through the rift in the Stronghold
Find an Ember Core in the Kiln
Find a Stone Heart in the Bedrock
Show the Magister what the fire and the stone were made of

q_world_made_1.completion: Warm, both of them. Orrin had thought the stone would be cold.

q_world_made_2.name: The Sea and the Sky
q_world_made_2.summary: Further in, the sea and the sky: a Tide Pearl from the Deeps and a Gale Plume from the Firmament.

stages.desc: Find a Tide Pearl in the Deeps
Find a Gale Plume in the Firmament
Show the Magister the sea and the sky

q_world_made_2.completion: Orrin laid the four at the edge of the old circle, and its lines brightened under them.

q_world_made_3.name: The Storm and the Whole
q_world_made_3.summary: The fifth is the storm, and past the storm is whatever holds the five together, at the Conflux.

stages.desc: Find Storm Glass in the Tempest
Put down the Quintessence at the Conflux
Bring the Heart of the Conflux to the Magister's circle
Show the Magister

q_world_made_3.completion: The circle in the Great Hall's floor took the light out of the heart and kept it, and every line in it came up gold, and stayed.
